resources.string: Early features. They may change or stop working, and each one stays off until you turn it on.
Watch bilibili.com videos with dual subtitles. Most subtitles need you to sign in to Bilibili. Opens Bilibili the first time you turn it on.
Watch bilibili.tv videos with dual subtitles. Opens bilibili.tv the first time you turn it on.
Sign in to Bilibili to load its subtitles
Bilibili shows most subtitles only to signed-in viewers. Sign in on the Bilibili page here (the app never sees your password), then tap Try again.
Bilibili lists no subtitles for this video. Try another video.
